description: This file defines a value converter class 'VisibilityNegationConverter' used in a UWP application to toggle visibility states between 'Visible' and 'Collapsed'.

classes.name: VisibilityNegationConverter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IValueConverter to invert Visibility states.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a Visibility value to its negation (Visible to Collapsed and vice versa).

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Delegates to Convert to perform the reverse conversion.
